title: Soldiers Help Suppress Wildfire
description: Soldiers from Task Force First Round out of Joint Base Lewis-McChord assist fire fighters from Oregon and North Dakota to help suppress wildfires affecting Northeast Washington. They laid out fire hoses and removed vegetation to create a fire break.
